correctness.rationale: For every d>=2 and 0<a<ell, the support function gives the complete nonduplicated vertex and normal cone labelling. Independent Gaussian signs and half-normal magnitudes give exact angles and counts; coupling establishes strict order. Berry--Esseen applies uniformly to all signed half-normal sums; conditional bivariate Gaussian convergence gives the skew-normal law; exact 2D and 3D Gaussian orthant formulas give both finite moments. The checker directly tests the coordinate support map and angle normalization. Limitations: finite checks are corroboration only, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete spherical normal-cone angle spectrum of a canonical non-cubical but nearly cubical zonotope family is an intrinsically motivated Euclidean invariant, not a re-enumeration of its known faces. The dimension-uniform Gaussian sigmoid and non-symmetric skew-normal exposure law quantify a persistent contrast between uniformly chosen vertices and uniformly chosen directional supports; exact arcsine moments exhibit a square-root-order bias. This is a complete natural classification with an independently motivated asymptotic geometry question, not an arbitrary finite slice.
